name: Hugging Face Inference Providers API
rate_limits: Free tier: approximately a few hundred requests per hour with monthly credit cap. PRO ($9/mo) provides 20x more credits. Exact limits intentionally undocumented and subject to change.
notes: Unified gateway to hundreds of ML models across 18+ inference providers (Cerebras, Groq, Together, Replicate, etc.). OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. Supports text generation (LLM/VLM), embeddings, image/video generation, speech, NER, summarization, and more. Free tier includes monthly credits for experimentation. Provider selection: automatic (fastest/cheapest) or explicit. Drop-in OpenAI SDK replacement. Extremely valuable for AI self-improvement: access to thousands of specialized models, feature extraction, embeddings for RAG, multi-modal capabilities. Requires HF token with inference permissions.
